step.name: End-to-end bitstream build via manager
step.description: Run 'firesim buildbitstream' for the V80 config to test the full manager-orchestrated build flow: Golden Gate generates FireSim-generated.sv, manager copies cl_firesim/ to the build area, generated RTL is placed in the design/ directory, build-bitstream.sh invokes Vivado synthesis + implementation + PDI generation. The build recipe (xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic) is already in config_build_recipes.yaml and config_build.yaml references it. The existing debug PDI build (cl_firesim_debug, May 29) proved Vivado can synthesize and implement the design; this step validates the manager orchestration.
success_criteria: firesim buildbitstream command launches without errors
Golden Gate RTL generation completes and FireSim-generated.sv is produced
Vivado synthesis completes without critical errors
PDI file is generated and bitstream is packaged by the manager
No timing violations above the acceptable threshold in the timing report
Build artifacts are registered in HWDB (or ready for registration)

parts.description: Create NSS UID fix library and wrapper for container environment. The container runs as UID 19696 but /etc/passwd has ray:x:1000. Python's pwd module, Fabric's SSH client, and getpass all fail with 'uid not found'. Build a small LD_PRELOAD shared library (nss_uid_fix.so) that intercepts getpwuid/getpwnam/getpwuid_r/getpwnam_r to map UID 19696 → ray with home=/home/ray. Install it persistently under $FIRESIM/deploy/utils/ and create a firesim-local wrapper script that sets LD_PRELOAD before invoking the firesim command. The C source, compiled .so, and wrapper script should all live under $FIRESIM/deploy/. Verify with: LD_PRELOAD=<path>/nss_uid_fix.so python3 -c 'import getpass; print(getpass.getuser())' prints 'ray'.
parts.build_command: cd $FIRESIM/deploy && gcc -shared -fPIC -o nss_uid_fix.so nss_uid_fix.c -ldl && chmod +x firesim-local && LD_PRELOAD=$FIRESIM/deploy/nss_uid_fix.so python3 -c "import getpass; print(getpass.getuser())"
parts.done_when: nss_uid_fix.so compiles, firesim-local wrapper exists, and 'LD_PRELOAD=.../nss_uid_fix.so python3 -c import getpass; print(getpass.getuser())' prints 'ray'

parts.description: Modify BitBuilder in bitbuilder.py to support localhost builds without SSH. The manager uses Fabric's run() and rsync_project() which require SSH even to localhost, but no sshd is accessible from this container. Add helper methods to BitBuilder base class: (1) _is_localhost() checks if env.host_string is 'localhost' or '127.0.0.1'; (2) _exec(cmd, **kwargs) dispatches to local(cmd, capture=True) for localhost or run(cmd, **kwargs) for remote; (3) _rsync_files(local_dir, remote_dir, upload=True, exclude=None, extra_opts='') dispatches to local('rsync -a ...') for localhost or rsync_project() for remote. Then modify: (A) BitBuilder.replace_rtl() — replace run() with self._exec() inside the prefix() context; (B) BitBuilder.build_driver() — replace run() with self._exec(); (C) XilinxAlveoBitBuilder.cl_dir_setup() — replace run() with self._exec() and rsync_project() with self._rsync_files(); (D) XilinxAlveoBitBuilder.build_bitstream() — replace run() with self._exec() and rsync_project() with self._rsync_files(), keeping settings(warn_only=True) for the Vivado invocation. IMPORTANT: For local rsync in _rsync_files, omit ssh_opts entirely (use 'rsync -aL <src> <dst>' without -e ssh). The prefix() context manager works correctly with local() in Fabric 1.x (verified). Do NOT modify remote-host behavior; only change behavior when _is_localhost() is True.
parts.build_command: cd $FIRESIM/deploy && LD_PRELOAD=$FIRESIM/deploy/nss_uid_fix.so python3 -c "from buildtools.bitbuilder import XilinxAlveoV80BitBuilder; print('Import OK')" && LD_PRELOAD=$FIRESIM/deploy/nss_uid_fix.so python3 -c "from fabric.api import env, execute, local, prefix; env.host_string='localhost'; from buildtools.bitbuilder import BitBuilder; b = BitBuilder.__new__(BitBuilder); print('localhost?', b._is_localhost()); print('All OK')"
parts.done_when: bitbuilder.py imports without error; _is_localhost() returns True when env.host_string='localhost'; a smoke test calling _exec('echo hello') from localhost returns 'hello' via local() without attempting SSH

parts.description: Update config_build.yaml and config_build_farm.yaml for V80 bitstream build. (A) In $FIRESIM/deploy/config_build.yaml: change builds_to_run from 'midasexamples_gcd' to 'xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic'; set default_build_dir under build_farm.recipe_arg_overrides to '$FIRESIM/build_area' (use the literal path /home/ray/chipyard/sims/firesim/build_area since YAML doesn't expand env vars); create the build_area directory. (B) Ensure the build farm recipe (build-farm-recipes/externally_provisioned.yaml) has matching default_build_dir. Note: the recipe's xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic is already defined in config_build_recipes.yaml with PLATFORM=xilinx_alveo_v80, TARGET_CONFIG=WithDefaultFireSimBridges_WithFireSimConfigTweaks_chipyard.RocketConfig, PLATFORM_CONFIG=BaseXilinxAlveoV80Config, frequency=75, strategy=TIMING.
parts.build_command: mkdir -p /home/ray/chipyard/sims/firesim/build_area && cd $FIRESIM/deploy && LD_PRELOAD=$FIRESIM/deploy/nss_uid_fix.so python3 -c "import yaml; cfg = yaml.safe_load(open('config_build.yaml')); print('builds:', cfg['builds_to_run']); print('build_dir:', cfg['build_farm']['recipe_arg_overrides']['default_build_dir'])"
parts.done_when: config_build.yaml parses correctly with builds_to_run containing 'xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic' and default_build_dir set to a writable path; the build_area directory exists

parts.description: Fix ADEF-911 DRC failure in Vivado write_device_image step. The June 5 build failed because BUFGCE cells generated by FIRRTL have SIM_DEVICE=ULTRASCALE but Versal requires VERSAL_HBM. The post_synth.tcl script fixes them in-memory but the fix doesn't persist to the on-disk checkpoint used by launch_runs. The pre_write_device_image.tcl TCL.PRE hook (which downgrades ADEF-911 to a warning) was set AFTER the first launch_runs completed, and Vivado 2025.1 doesn't apply it to the spawned subprocess. Fix this with a two-pronged approach: (A) In $FIRESIM/platforms/xilinx_alveo_v80/cl_firesim/scripts/implementation.tcl, move the 'set_property STEPS.WRITE_DEVICE_IMAGE.TCL.PRE' line to BEFORE the first 'launch_runs' call (right after the reset_runs and set_property -dict block). This ensures the hook is part of the initial run configuration. (B) In $FIRESIM/platforms/xilinx_alveo_v80/cl_firesim/scripts/synthesis.tcl, add a STEPS.SYNTH_DESIGN.TCL.POST hook that fixes BUFGCE SIM_DEVICE inside the synthesis subprocess (before the checkpoint is saved). Create a new file post_synth_in_context.tcl in the scripts/ directory containing: 'foreach cell [get_cells -hierarchical -filter {REF_NAME == BUFGCE} -quiet] { set_property SIM_DEVICE VERSAL_HBM $cell }'. In synthesis.tcl, add 'set_property STEPS.SYNTH_DESIGN.TCL.POST ${root_dir}/scripts/post_synth_in_context.tcl ${synth_run}' before the launch_runs call. This belt-and-suspenders approach ensures BUFGCEs are fixed in the persistent checkpoint AND the DRC check is downgraded.
parts.build_command: cd $FIRESIM/platforms/xilinx_alveo_v80/cl_firesim/scripts && grep -n 'WRITE_DEVICE_IMAGE.TCL.PRE' implementation.tcl && grep -n 'SYNTH_DESIGN.TCL.POST' synthesis.tcl && cat post_synth_in_context.tcl
parts.done_when: implementation.tcl has WRITE_DEVICE_IMAGE.TCL.PRE set BEFORE the first launch_runs call; synthesis.tcl has SYNTH_DESIGN.TCL.POST set before launch_runs; post_synth_in_context.tcl exists with the BUFGCE SIM_DEVICE fix

parts.description: Run firesim buildbitstream end-to-end for the V80 config and verify completion. Source the environment, then run the build via the firesim-local wrapper (which sets LD_PRELOAD). The build has three phases: (1) Golden Gate RTL generation (replace-rtl: runs SBT/Chisel to generate FireSim-generated.sv — expect ~30-60 min), (2) Driver build (~5 min), (3) Vivado synthesis + implementation + PDI generation (~4-8 hours). Monitor the build log. The build succeeds when: (a) FireSim-generated.sv is produced in the build area design/ directory, (b) Vivado synthesis completes without errors, (c) Vivado implementation completes with WNS >= 0 and WHS >= 0 (timing met), (d) firesim.pdi is generated in vivado_proj/, (e) firesim.bit (copy of PDI) and firesim.mcs (placeholder) exist, (f) the manager creates a HWDB entry in deploy/built-hwdb-entries/. If the build fails at any stage, examine the log, fix the issue, and retry. The Vivado build uses TIMING strategy at 75 MHz on the xcv80-lsva4737-2MHP-e-S part. Note: since this build takes many hours, if the agent encounters issues during the RTL generation phase, it should focus on fixing those first before proceeding to the Vivado phase.
parts.build_command: cd /home/ray/chipyard/sims/firesim && source sourceme-manager.sh --skip-ssh-setup 2>/dev/null; cd deploy && LD_PRELOAD=$FIRESIM/deploy/nss_uid_fix.so python3 firesim buildbitstream
parts.done_when: firesim buildbitstream completes without error; FireSim-generated.sv exists in the build area; Vivado synthesis and implementation logs show no critical errors; firesim.pdi is generated; timing report shows WNS >= 0; HWDB entry file exists in deploy/built-hwdb-entries/xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic
